name: Paneer Quesadilla
steps: Cut paneer into small cubes. Finely dice onion and pepper, removing pepper seeds; chop coriander.
Heat 10 ml oil in a pan. Cook onion and pepper for 5 minutes, then add paneer, cumin, paprika and salt and cook for 3 minutes.
Switch off the heat and fold in lime juice and coriander. Keep the filling dry and divide it into 4 equal portions.
Lay out 4 large tortillas. Sprinkle half the cheese over one half of each, add paneer filling and top with remaining cheese. Fold the empty halves over.
Brush a skillet with remaining 10 ml oil across batches. Cook folded tortillas over medium-low heat for 3 minutes per side until crisp and cheese melts. Rest briefly and cut into wedges.
tips: Choose vegetarian-rennet cheddar and keep the heat moderate so the cheese melts before the tortillas darken.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
